text:
maya: quick flagging — noticed quota burn spike in console, top contributors are projectless keys hitting reserved fallback pool
liam: do we have trace ids or router samples? could be a misrouted burst
maya: samples: c0ffee1, c0ffee2. router lines show policy=ambient and origin=unattributed
sara: this smells like the attribution sampler lagging behind ingestion. when sampler hasn't populated project claim, router falls back to ambient routing
devex: customers see cost in their org dashboards delayed. Console shows 'Unknown project' bar and lots of support tickets
anton: short term: consider preferring X-Origin-Org header if present and valid, before ambient. long term: make attribution a first-class signal in routing decisions and telemetry
liam: header heuristic sounds ok but add guardrails: (a) verify org membership against key grants, (b) emit `routing.header_org_override` event when used
maya: and emit `attribution_state` tag in spans with values: attributed|sampling_pending|fallback. That way dashboards can split latency and cost by real attribution state
sara: yes. dashboards currently show pool usage only which conflates attribution issues. adding tag lets us create panels for sampling_pending rate and page when it rises
devex: small UX change: show a subtle banner on the pools page when sampling_pending > 8%: "Some traffic is routed to fallback while attribution catches up — see troubleshooting" with link to docs
liam: rollout: (1) add span tag + telemetry event in canary, (2) add header-heuristic behind feature flag, (3) update dashboard & add banner, (4) monitor alignment between billing attribution and observed pool counts for 24h
anton: i'll wire the feature flag (feature.attribution_header_heuristic) and the router PR. i'll also make the header-org-mismatch event emit with reason codes
maya: alert proposal: page eng-sre if fallback_pool_rate > 12% AND sampling_pending_rate > 4% for 10m. I'll volunteer to watch the first canary window
devex: i'll draft the banner copy and a tiny console toggle for the flag so we can flip per region
sara: i'll update grafana dashboards to use `attribution_state` tag and add rate panels and a runbook link
ops-bot: Canary deploy started: router v2.15.0-canary (attr-sampling-20260322) to 10% of traffic
liam: remember edge case: delegated service accounts where header should not override. add an allowlist check for token type
anton: good catch. will add token_type != delegated_sa as a precondition
maya: thanks. if canary looks clean after 6h we'll bump to 50% then full. posting PRs now
sara: :thumbsup:
